name: Cult Leader
summary: Referred to as fanatics, lunatics, or obsessives, cultists see themselves as genuine devotees of their deity.
replacesText: Class Skills; Skill Ranks; Weapon/Armor Proficiencies; Focus Weapon; 3rd, 9th, 12th, and 15th-level Bonus Feats; Channel Energy
mechanicalNotes: Replacement progression is automated. Bespoke effects without a shared builder subsystem remain descriptive.

features.name: Class Skills
features.summary: The cult leader’s class skills are Acrobatics (Dex), Bluff (Cha), Climb (Str), Craft (Int), Diplomacy (Cha), Disguise (Cha), Escape Artist (Dex), Heal (Wis), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (local) (Int), Knowledge (religion) (Int), Perception (Wis), Profession (Wis), Sense Motive (Wis), Slight of Hand (Dex), Spellcraft (Int), and Stealth (Dex). These skills replace the warpriest’s class skills.

features.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
features.summary: Cult leaders are proficient with all simple weapons, plus the hand crossbow, rapier, sap, shortbow, and short sword, as well as the favored weapon of their deity. They are proficient with light armor and light shields. The cult leader does not gain Weapon Focus as a bonus feat as a warpriest normally would. This replaces the warpriest’s weapon and armor proficiencies.

features.name: Well-Hidden (Ex)
features.summary: A cult leader gains a +2 bonus on Disguise and Stealth checks. This ability replaces focus weapon.

features.name: Sneak Attack (Ex)
features.summary: At 3rd level, a cult leader gains the sneak attack ability, as the rogue class feature. If he already has sneak attack from another class, the extra damage from the classes that grant sneak attack stack for the purpose of determining the sneak attack’s extra damage dice. This extra damage is 1d6 at 3rd level and increases by 1d6 every 3 levels thereafter. This ability replaces the bonus feats gained at 3rd, 9th, and 15th levels.

features.name: Enthrall (Sp)
features.summary: At 4th level, a cult leader can cast enthrall. Using this ability consumes two uses of his fervor ability. This ability replaces channel energy.

features.name: Hide in Plain Sight (Su)
features.summary: At 12th level, a cult leader can use the Stealth skill even while being observed. As long as he is within 10 feet of an area of dim light, a cult leader can hide himself from view in the open without anything to actually hide behind. He cannot, however, hide in his own shadow. This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 12th level.
